notes.title: Customer is always right!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello there, future Electricians! 👋[/b][/h1]

Last week we talked about the packages and the contents of them but, we haven't touched upon the people that send them.

Well now is the time! 🔥

[h3][b]First Customers and Reputation[/b][/h3]

Well everyone has to start somewhere, you have no reputation, no real proof of your expertise yet.

So no rich investor will show up with a plethora of equipment to fix for thousands yet. 🤑
But you have your neighbourhood! 🏘️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/d33659cd65c3f0fba8c6c0f9aafa481fa16d622c.gif[/img]

Plenty of grannies with new equipment they don't understand, family men with phones damaged by kids. A bunch of customers right at your door... boring? Wait wait don't leave, give me a second to explain why it is much more exciting than it sounds. 💯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/74a45a9c81fc84fcb628e74b7fe47d5bfd03e0a5.gif[/img]

Every order, no matter how small, can start a big story. Improving your reputation isn't the only way to unlock more contracts. Satisfying your customers will make them come back and give you more of their equipment, more interactions, more ways to learn about them. And also access to other customers.

There is nothing better than word-of-mouth to mouth advertisement. 💬

You did a quick job in fixing a teenager's phone, his uncle gets interested if his specialized sound equipment can get fixed. And that is a proper source of income 😎 🔊

[h3][b]More than just an electrician[/b][/h3]

In modern times people's phones, laptops, and hard drives have become a reflection of their lives. 🖥️

Everything is stored on them, and you will often have access to it… 👀

During your career you will have to make many decisions, accept or refuse many difficult offers. Some of them will open access to further commissions and more chances to interact with the clients, some will block them. You will control how much you want to be in people's lives, and what type of electronics technician you want to be.  😈 😇

There are no wrong options, every decision has consequences that it will be for you to interpret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/e2179e65494f940f174ddc1c0efecc7d47f04f9b.gif[/img]

Well that's it for now. See you next week!

It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator is still very early in development and we are excited to hear what thing you would want to see in the game! Feel free to share it on our official discord!
[url=https://discord.gg/BQjqUb8v][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/cfbb6515773936a9bce1a745cd6445ff0ba2656e.png[/img][/url]

See you out there,
It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Team

notes.title: A package at your doors!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, Technicians! 👋[/h1]

[h3]Another day, another devlog is here! 🙌[/h3]

[h3]And today we're gonna talk about humble yet so important thing in our life. [/h3]

[h2][b]Packages! 📦[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/7b089a3f78edec4679cc5402b0539f391ad51f7a.gif[/img]

[h3]Well maybe not directly about them but about what is going on in them. 👀[/h3]

First of all to fix things you need tools.[b] And parts. LOTS of parts 🔩[/b]
To get most of them you will have to order them from your desktop, there will be a bunch of variety, at least dozens of them so you need to really know what you need before ordering. 
There is just one letter difference in the name and half the price, it must be similar, right? Nope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/335c1ea1f7fec259aa7363653e61eedbe167c411.gif[/img]

[b]If you are terrified, don't worry everything will be unlocked gradually to not overhelm you with the knowledge of "does it go in the speakers, or the monitor?" 😅[/b]

[h3]That is the first type of packages, your orders, but there is also a second one.[/h3]

[h3][b]Online Orders[/b][/h3]
As you get a bit of renown, experience, tools, and doing neighborhood commissions is not enough to make a buck, you get access to online commissions.

An endless plethora of them with various requests, and every well done job can improve your reputation immensely! The power of the internet is here! 🌐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/734d526519546f81e384c6b52b1a431bb00c43f3.gif[/img]

There is gonna be a variety of requests, some more special than the others, and some may have unexpected out of nothing conditions.  🔋

People don't really know much about what is going on inside their hardware, who can blame them, and sometimes an easy to look fix may take much longer than you thought. Well, the harder the challenge, the sweeter the price! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/3fe47997f7a9c63a856ed67d7b78be7c171db8a4.gif[/img]


This is it for now, but don't worry, we have a lot more coming in the near future!

To have all the freshest news, don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b], and we invite you to join us in our official discord, where we welcome all sorts of ideas and feedback! 💬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/cfbb6515773936a9bce1a745cd6445ff0ba2656e.png[/img]

Keep in touch! 🎉
It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Team

notes.title: Set it up!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Technicians! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Another day, another chapter for It Works: Electronic Repair Simulator is here! ⚡[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]In this devlog we want to talk about something that all of us need... a home! We talked about it previously but it's time to show you more! 🏠[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]So let's take a walk through a part of it![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=GUCMhOkaQEM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b][u]Gently with packages[/u][/b][/h3]
Your home is your base of operation, a place where you will be buying your equipment, fixing customer's electronics, accepting their orders and of course taking care of the packages for them like they are your own! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/8dcc2ab3808ef47048424551d2e9d5903b1e70cb.gif[/img]

[h3][b][u]The Rough Start[/u][/b][/h3]
Of course, at the beginning your base won't look like a workshop of your dreams, but with enough care, and funds it will be more and more similar to something you need.

Rooms that haven't got any use will slowly change into something more out of an electrician's dream where you will be able to customize to your heart's content! 🔌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/757c8eb73faf07e9180257a18a844633a2c563a0.gif[/img]

[h3][b][u]Set it all up[/u]![/b][/h3]
A lot of items can be moved around in the game, so you will have a lot of freedom to set up everything the way you want, including your packages. If you want to improve your workflow, you can! 📦

It's just gonna be with various outcomes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/4b43652e5f55015f9d4bfef6bd1fb1f62335c6dc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]I'm sure nothing happened to those delicate electronics! 👍[/b][/h3]

That is it for now, but don't worry, more will be coming very soon! 😎

We invite you to give us more of your thoughts, ideas, suggestions, whatever you would want to see in It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator. You can do it  in the Steam discussions or join us on our Discord! 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/cfbb6515773936a9bce1a745cd6445ff0ba2656e.png[/img]

Thank you for tuning in!
It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Team

notes.title: Humble Beginnings
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello there, future Techmasters! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]After all the warm responses to the announcement and the trailer,[b] here we go! 🔥[/b] [/h2]

[b]We know you are hyped, we know you are waiting,[/b] so it's time to show you a bit more of what awaits you in It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/96ccecb75dd6bde25d6b76dad576f8c5430dd945.gif[/img]


[h3]So how does your journey start in the game? Well of course with the humble beginnigns of a rookie IT specialist... in your mother's home. 🏠
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/cb36686939ca70fa3ff2a5c9aeef8a921b2f79c2.gif[/img]

I know, I know it sounds a bit stereotypical, not all people focusing on electronics live in their mother's basement or garage filled with dad's fishing equipment but it is a nice, humble start that with time, and growing funds allow it to evolve into a more, personalised vibe. 

You will be able to fill your home with a plethora of  furniture, add some of your own fluff and fill your fridges with a bunch of energy drinks for all the working nights you have to go through! 🥱

From a [b]starting casual workshop your workspace will evolve naturally into a reliable center[/b] filled with a whole bunch of equipment, dues to more and more complex jobs. 🧰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/3319a3d19a9a717846437ea7ac8e045475d7fd2d.gif[/img]

Everyone has to start somewhere, and the start is You being neighborhood's younger "nephew". You don't have reputation yet to take on more complex tasks, and let's be honest, every grandma needs some help with the complex technology, can't really blame them, this thing is dark magic!

[b]Maybe it won't start with absolute extremes like unplugging the equipment and plugging it back  in front of them and magically "IT WORKS!"[/b], the first requests will require at least some effort. Switching the battery in the phone, changing the cracked screen, cleaning a mouse covered in sticky soda, that kind of thing!  🥤

You have the gifted hands and while for them you sudennly make IT WORK with barely doing anything, you get to understand how the equipment works from within. 😎


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/c3da38404cd8023a1743107015886601391fa718.gif[/img]

Of course in the future there will be much more complex requests, with more specific equipment, and each of them will require a special approach, whether using completely new tools, figuring out how sound system works 🔊, or even have a bit of a narrative twist in some of them, leaving you to  make many choices that shapes the worker you are... 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/e2179e65494f940f174ddc1c0efecc7d47f04f9b.gif[/img]

Well this is it for now, can't give you all the cool things at once! As the development will evolve, we will definitely share more of the details, this is just one devlog out of many! So be on the lookout, more will be shared soon.

To be definitely on the par with the freshest news, don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b], and we invite to join us in our official discord, where we welcome all sorts of ideas and feedback! 💬
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681857/cfbb6515773936a9bce1a745cd6445ff0ba2656e.png[/img]

Keep in touch! 🎉
